title: Consistent intercept estimation and inference for unit-root INAR(2) processes
summary: \citet{barczy2014asymptotic} showed that the ordinary least-squares (OLS) estimator of the innovation mean is inconsistent for a unit-root INAR(2) process. We construct a consistent intercept estimator using inverse-time weighted least squares (WLS) and derive its mixed-rate asymptotics: the intercept estimator is asymptotically normal at rate $\sqrt{\log n}$, with a Gaussian limit independent of the autoregressive limits, while the autoregressive estimators retain their OLS rates.
